free_tier.stated: Time-limited new-user packages only: OBS Single-AZ 100 GB for 12 months (regions CN-Hong Kong, AP-Bangkok, AP-Singapore, AF-Johannesburg) per the package listing; a separate enterprise-verified 500 GB/month for 3 months offer (China regions) is reported by a third-party comparison, and the vendor's own free-OBS landing page returns 404, so the 500 GB figure is unverified.

egress.terms: OBS outbound internet traffic is sold as a separate monthly-resetting package ('Outbound Internet traffic packages ... reset their quota by month'); no free egress allowance appears in the free-trial packages.

tooling: OBS S3-compatible API — rclone 's3' provider 'Huawei OBS'; OBS Browser+; SDKs. Public-read buckets and temporary URLs available.
chaining: New users registered after 2025-01-01, 12 months, one package per product per account. Enterprise verification needed for the larger OBS quota.
limits_note: 100 GB / 12 months (individual, single-AZ); storage packages do NOT reset monthly ('No monthly quota reset'); egress never free.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'iaas'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Solid storage; the 12-month cliff and paid egress make it a staging area rather than a store.

evidence.proved: 'Free packages for all: Customers who register ... after January 1, 2025 ... for 12 months from the registration date'
outbound traffic packages reset monthly; standard storage packages do not
